core_obligations: Reduce to spaces: the space-level characterization together with the description of limits of topological groups reduces the assertion to showing that a profinite group is a cofiltered limit of finite discrete groups (proof lines 6007-6011)

Neighbourhoods contain open subgroups: a continuous map to a finite discrete space separating the neutral element's fibre inside a given neighbourhood yields the subgroup of elements acting trivially on the left, whose openness is proved by a quasi-compactness argument (proof lines 6012-6034)

Open subgroups have finite index and contain open normal subgroups: quasi-compactness makes the index finite, and intersecting the conjugates gives an open normal subgroup contained in it (proof lines 6035-6042)

Conclusion: the map into the cofiltered limit over open normal subgroups is injective because every neighbourhood contains one and surjective by the finite intersection criterion, hence a homeomorphism and an isomorphism of topological groups (proof lines 6043-6058)
proof_roadmap: 由拓扑空间版（lemma-profinite）与「拓扑群极限按底层空间与群计算」把问题化为「profinite 群是有限离散群的余滤极限」。
先证每个单位元邻域 E 含开子群：取到有限离散空间的 f 使 f^{-1}(f(e)) ⊂ E，令 H = {g : ∀g', f(gg') = f(g')}；用 W = f^{-1}({t}) 的准紧性与乘积落在 W 内的性质构造单位元开邻域，得 H 开。
开子群 H 指数有限（准紧）⇒ 取共轭之交得开正规子群 N ⊂ H ⇒ G/N 有限离散。
映射 G → lim_{N} G/N 单射（每个邻域含某个 N）＋满射（有限交判据）⇒ 同胚 ⇒ 拓扑群同构；N 之交仍开正规 ⇒ 右端余滤。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement characterizes profinite topological groups as cofiltered limits of finite discrete topological groups (author lemma at source lines 5997-6005, label lemma-profinite-group). The proof (source lines 6007-6059) reduces to the space-level statement, shows that every neighbourhood of the neutral element contains an open subgroup by a quasi-compactness argument, uses finiteness of the index to pass to open normal subgroups and identifies the group with the cofiltered limit over them (proof lines 6007-6058). The neighbourhood-contains-an-open-subgroup step is the substance. H3.
